title: Diploma in Cyber Security
subject: Cyber Security & Ethical Hacking
description: A rigorous 10-month professional diploma combining theoretical defense engineering, hands-on offensive security laboratories, CTF challenge solving, SOC/SIEM operations, and a capstone enterprise cyber range final project.
prerequisites: Basic computing, hardware familiarity, and high school mathematics.
target_audience: Aspiring Cybersecurity Specialists, SOC Analysts, Penetration Testers, and IT Security Administrators.

modules.title: Computer Architecture & Systems Fundamentals
lessons: CPU Registers, Memory Hierarchy & Execution Flow
BIOS/UEFI, Secure Boot & Hardware Security Modules

modules.title: Computer Networking Fundamentals & Protocols
lessons: OSI 7 Layers & TCP/IP Model Deep Dive
Core Protocols: ARP, DHCP, DNS, HTTP/S, SSH

modules.title: Identity, Access Management & Authentication
lessons: Identity Federation: OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect & SAML

modules.title: Web Application Security & OWASP Top 10
lessons: Injection Attacks: SQLi, NoSQLi & OS Command Injection

modules.title: SOC Operations, SIEM & Incident Response
lessons: SOC Architecture, Roles & MITRE ATT&CK Framework
SIEM Deployment & Log Ingestion with Wazuh

modules.title: Digital Forensics & Malware Fundamentals
lessons: Digital Evidence Handling & Chain of Custody

modules.title: Python for Cyber Security
lessons: Python Scripting Fundamentals & Regex for Security
Socket Programming: Port Scanners & Banner Grabbers
Security Automation: Log Analyzers & File Integrity Checkers
Threat Intelligence APIs & Automated IOC Lookup

modules.title: Cloud Security, DevSecOps & Modern Cyber Security
lessons: Cloud Architecture, Shared Responsibility & IAM Least Privilege
Zero Trust Architecture & Modern Perimeter Defense

modules.title: Integrated Cyber Security Laboratory & Capstone
lessons: Capstone Proposal & Enterprise Cyber Range Architecture
